news.headline: Kitewing Assist now answers technicians in Spanish (beta)
news.details: Spanish-language troubleshooting answers and job summaries in Kitewing Assist, requested by technicians at Greystone Facilities Group during their pilot. Beta for Growth and Enterprise customers from 2026-11-17.

news.headline: Greystone Facilities Group reaches 86% first-time-fix across five branches
news.details: Up from 71% before Kitewing FieldOps; overtime down 22% and invoices out in 2 days instead of 9 (case study CS-01). Quote from Walter Ashby, VP Field Operations: 'We finally run five branches as one company.'

news.headline: Route Optimizer live re-sequencing is generally available
news.details: Routes now re-sequence automatically when traffic or a cancelled job changes the day. Copperline Plumbing & Drain cut drive time per job by 18% (CS-02).

news.headline: Kitewing is a finalist for 'Best Small Workplace' (Cedar Harbor Business Journal)
news.details: 62 people, 2 offices, meeting-free 'focus Friday' afternoons, a $1,500 learning budget per person. Winners announced 2026-12-04.

news.headline: Webinar recap: Beating the spring rush
news.details: 240 registrants, 131 live attendees. Top tip: book maintenance visits in the shoulder season to flatten the March peak. Recording on the Kitewing resources page.
